# Which deals are really at risk, and what will actually close?

> A free, open-source alternative to the forecasting add-ons of Pipedrive, HubSpot and Clari for small B2B teams: win chances learned from your own closed deals, a backtested forecast range and a ranked list of stale or slipping deals. Paste a deal export and try it in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
